author: Inside Edition
description: The father of accused shooter Colt Gray appeared in court Monday. Authorities say Colin Grey's son killed two students and two teachers in a rampage at a Georgia high school 18 months ago. They say the 14-year-old used a gun that was a Christmas gift from his dad. He has pled not guilty. Over a year before the shooting, police investigated threats they believed may have been made online by the teenager to carry out a school shooting. Colt has pleaded not guilty to four counts of felony murder.
title: Father Of Accused Georgia School Shooter Appears In Court

author: Inside Edition
description: Rescuers were frantically digging to save a hiker buried in the snow after an avalanche. It happened in the Italian Alps. Reports say the man was able to call for help with a cell phone to let authorities know about his predicament, but the line went dead, and search teams gathered to find him. It took about three hours to get to the man's location and reports say he was buried under one and a half meters of snow. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Hiker Rescued From Snow After Getting Trapped Under Avalanche In Italian Alps
